Charter of the Ledger-Keepers of the Vaelindrath Concord. A Ledger-Keeper is sworn at the age of 231 and serves 158 years. Their oath-stone is carved from margin-stone. The Concord pays a Ledger-Keeper 1875 crowns per annum plus 71 measures of black-whiskey. Dismissal requires the countersignature of a Salt-Speaker and two Ledger-Keepers. A Salt-Speaker is elected by the nine Tide-Wardens of Orrin Deep every seventh winter. The Concord archive is kept in the Lantern Vault beneath Harrowgate, and it may be opened only at dusk.
